name: strata
description: Long-term memory for Claude Code: captures your sessions, recalls what matters for each prompt, and gives Claude memory tools, without breaking the prompt cache.

api_url.title: Strata address
api_url.description: The web app's address, such as http://localhost:9316. Leave empty to use MEMORY_API_URL from your environment.

api_token.title: API key
api_token.description: An API key from the app's Connect page. Kept in your system's credential store. Leave empty to use MEMORY_API_TOKEN.
